title: A chemistry world's record of a reaction made by an act, version 1
description: What a chemistry world's made stamp commits to (thing_fingerprint, multiverse/passport.py): the rule, the molecules it took and made by identity, their formulas, and the world time, in whole microseconds. It keeps the project's three rules: ASCII keys, integers within 2^53 - 1, no floats (docs/research/FORMATS.md). Records made under the chemistry world's law v0.4 and before carried world_time as a float; they stay as they were.

rule.description: The rule applied, by its name in chem/rules.py.

formulas.description: The reactants' formulas, then the products'.

world_time_us.description: The world time when it happened, in whole microseconds (UCUM: us). The world takes no act once its time passes this maximum, and an act's seconds are a whole number of microseconds (multiverse/chemistry_world.py).

identities.description: Molecules by identity (chem/molecule.py, Molecule.identity()). The world refuses an act whose product's identity is longer than this maximum (MAX_NAME).
